summary: Solaris Energy Infrastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending a prior 8-K to clarify that its acquisition of Focus Genco Cayman Ltd., reported as consummated on March 16, 2026, does not constitute a significant asset acquisition under Rule 3-05 of Regulation S-X. No financial statements or pro forma information for Genco are required. The filing is purely a regulatory compliance correction with no special-situation event. No price, premium, or deal terms are provided. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing contains no risk-arb angle or actionable structural detail.
